blocks: UPSC Topper List 2025 Out: The Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) has released the UPSC CSE Final Result for the 2025 cycle on March 6, 2026, on the portal. UPSC Topper List 2025 has been released along with the result announcement on the official website. Anuj Agnihotri has secured AIR 1 in the CSE final examination. Rajeshwari Suve M secured the AIR 2 rank, and she is the female topper in the UPSC CSE examination. A total of 958 candidates have been recommended for the IAS, IPS, IFS, and IRS services, depending on their marks.

UPSC Toppers 2025 List has been published along with the result announcement. The final merit list considers performance in both the main examination and the personal interview. The UPSC Topper List 2025 includes roll numbers, names and categories. The Top 10 UPSC Topper List 2025 includes top-scoring candidates, who are Anuj Agnihotri, Rajeshwari Suve M, Akansh Dhull, and Raghav Jhunjhunwala. UPSC will soon display written marks, interview marks, and total scores.
